listing.name: Until Dawn (2015 PS4 original) — UntilDawn_PC (SuperCatElvis) (SuperCatElvis)
listing.summary: Information only. The project retains a complete-playthrough claim on its i9-12900KF/RTX 3090 Ti development PC. WIP 0.1.4 adds a renderer thread, faster rendering, a hair fix and more movie skipping, with missing Skip text still noted. The new renderer has only been played on NVIDIA; RX 9070 XT observations concern WIP 0.1.3. Reported scenes range from about 60 FPS in light scenes to 35–45 FPS in busy scenes and 21–25 FPS at the heaviest points. Shader pauses, crashes, temporary deformation, motion drift and graphics defects remain. Renderer_thread=0 is the project’s fallback for threading regressions. Intel graphics are untested; native 4K and stable 60 FPS are goals. New downloads are unavailable while closed-source runtime provenance and distribution rights for game-derived shaders/icon remain unresolved. Original CUSA02636/update 01.03 and a native description do not resolve that condition. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
listing.download_block_reason: New downloads are unavailable while the closed-source player’s distribution/provenance remains unresolved, including declared game-derived shader programs and its icon. A native description or own-disc requirement does not approve those files. Information about original CUSA02636/update 01.03 and project-reported progress is retained under this entry’s existing identity. Exact package/source provenance must be resolved before downloads are offered.
